clips.title: The story
paras: Scarlet Commander Mograine serves as the military leader garrisoned inside the Cathedral of the Scarlet Monastery. A zealous paladin of the Scarlet Crusade, he defends the chapel alongside High Inquisitor Whitemane. Both the Horde and Alliance target him to disrupt the zealots threatening Tirisfal Glades and the surrounding lands.

Stationed within the grand Crusader's Chapel at the heart of the Scarlet Monastery, Scarlet Commander Mograine commands the standing garrison of the Scarlet Crusade. He wields the holy power of a paladin with ferocious dedication, relying on retribution, divine shields, and stunning blows to shatter any whom the Crusade deems corrupted or unclean.
